Alongside his colleagues, he solved numerous major cases while staying true to his original aspiration of 'serving the people.' This legendary detective not only witnessed the evolution of China's public security system but also stood as a living testament to the rise of New China.

movies.title: Once Upon a Time in Harlem
movies.overview: A decade after his death, genre-defying filmmaker William Greaves has one last trick up his sleeve with what he considered the most important event he captured on film: a 1972 party he engineered with the living luminaries of the Harlem Renaissance.

movies.title: Always Lalisa
movies.overview: Documentary following global superstar LISA during a transformative year away from BLACKPINK, the K-pop phenomenon that made her one of the world's most recognizable performers. Documenting a year of risk, reinvention, and self-discovery as LISA begins to define her next chapter.

movies.title: Love Language
movies.overview: After a failed engagement, a woman discovers a talent for writing wedding vows, but her growing success and new romance are complicated when she’s hired to write vows for her former college flame’s wedding.

movies.title: Paradise Lost
movies.overview: A bus full of children mysteriously vanishes. When an altered version of a grieving mother's son returns years later, she must grapple with the technologically revised reality she has created.

movies.title: Tu Hai Meri Kiran
movies.overview: What starts as a real connection for her turns into his all-consuming obsession. As love darkens, the boundary between devotion and danger fades.

movies.title: Portrait of an Artist: Stephen Curry
movies.overview: On the verge of his record-extending 4,000th career three-pointer, four-time NBA champion and two-time MVP Stephen Curry reflects on the upbringing, mindset, and work ethic that made him one of the most legendary artists of his time.

movies.title: Itllu Arjuna
movies.overview: A mute man with exceptional skills falls in love, proving that true feelings do not always need words.

movies.title: Merry Christmas Aubrey Flint
movies.overview: An amateur production of A Christmas Carol at a retirement home is reluctantly directed by reclusive man on community service.

movies.title: Devour
movies.overview: Stranded after a disastrous gig, an all-girl heavy metal band finds a woman in danger in a town ruled by a warlock, and crawling with cannibals, vampires, and a deadly werewolf, forcing them to fight for survival.

movies.title: Fresh Meat
movies.overview: In the back of a butcher shop, a little girl watches terrifying tales on a screen that must be fed. As its appetite grows, her father must find increasingly gruesome ways to keep the show going.
movies.director: James A. Janisse, Steven Schloss, Tim Smink, Jonnie Stapleton, Béla Baptiste, Jason Sheedy, Joshua David Matthews, Benjamin Baraad, MK Kopp, Sarah Stephens, Ethan Droze, Finn Bell, Vichhay Tek, Joshua Chislett, Brady Palubiski

movies.title: Soul Patrol
movies.overview: From deep behind enemy lines, a hidden chapter of American military history is uncovered, prompting the question of whether reckoning with the past can bring peace to those who lived it. The Vietnam War’s first Black special operations team reunites to tell their story.

movies.title: God with Us
movies.overview: In an urban Maryland neighborhood, virginal Mary Anne Thomas and her boyfriend Joseph 'Junie' Love find their lives turned upside down when Mary discovers she’s miraculously pregnant without ever being with a man. As disbelief, danger, and divine destiny converge, their love is tested in a community desperate for hope.

movies.title: DreamQuil
movies.overview: In a near future where poor air quality forces people into virtual lives, a dissatisfied mother joins a digital wellness retreat, only to return home and discover that a robotic replacement has taken her place, leading to a sinister mystery.

movies.title: Bohurupi: The Golden Daku
movies.overview: A cop tries to track down Bikram Pramanik, a master of disguise whose wife is a pickpocket.

movies.title: Her Song
movies.overview: Olivia, a Franco-American writer, returns to her ancestral village in the south of France to write the story of her grandmother, who fled Paris during the Nazi invasion during World War II. There, she meets Madeline, a talented local artist, who quickly replaces her grandmother as the face of the novel. As a number of strange coincidences ensue, fiction and reality intermingle uncannily, and Olivia starts to ask whether she's part of history's unfolding story, or vice-versa.

movies.title: The Irregular at Magic High School THE MOVIE - Yotsuba Succession Arc -
movies.overview: The invitation has arrived. It's time for the New Year's Reception at the Yotsuba family residence. This year, Miyuki and other candidates will gather there to decide who will be the next leader of their powerful clan. If chosen as successor, she would never again have to see her brother live as an outcast. At the same time, such a position would surely entail a political marriage, leaving her mind in complete turmoil. To complicate matters, the current head of the family sows doubt with a shocking statement. When the new year arrives, their relationship may change forever...

collection.name: The Irregular at Magic High School Collection

movies.title: Nuisance Bear
movies.overview: A polar bear is forced to navigate a human world of tourists, wildlife officers, and hunters as its ancient migration collides with modern life. When a sacred predator is branded a nuisance, it becomes unclear who truly belongs in this shared landscape.

movies.title: Winter of the Crow
movies.overview: Warsaw, 1981. Martial law shuts down the country, turning it into a prison overnight. Taxis are replaced by tanks, citizens are treated like criminals, and visiting British Professor Joan Andrews finds herself trapped. After witnessing the murder of a young student by the secret police, Joan herself becomes the target.

movies.title: On Behalf of My Son
movies.overview: Vicentina struggles to cope with the death of her son Wesley after a tragic bus accident, in which he was the driver. As the investigation unfolds, evidence suggests that Wesley’s actions may have been suicidal. Vicentina then embarks on a journey to seek out the victims’ families and apologize, while confronting her own grief and uncertainty.

movies.title: Closure
movies.overview: After his teenage son goes missing, Daniel scours the depths of the Vistula River, torn between the dread of a fatal leap and the hope that his son may still be alive.

movies.title: Ralph's Perfekt Christmas
movies.overview: To win back his wife, Christmas-obsessed Ralph concocts a crazy plan to kidnap the washed-up child star of his favorite Christmas movie. His scheme goes awry and spirals darkly out of control in an outrageous dark comedy with a horror twist that reveals two sides of one very desperate man determined to have his "Perfekt Christmas," no matter what - even if it lands him on the Naughty List.
movies.director: Matthew Bellamy, Tom McLaren, Mary McLaren

movies.title: Dead of Night
movies.overview: A small town is terrorized by a series of brutal murders, as a determined sheriff, his daughter, and a desperate mayor race to uncover the truth behind the killings before the town descends into chaos.

movies.title: Capturing Bigfoot
movies.overview: On October 20, 1967, Roger Patterson captured 60 seconds of film showing a creature walking through the Northern California woods—footage that became the most analyzed and debated in history. Fifty-seven years later, a reel of 16mm film discovered in a safe changes everything, revealing the untold story behind the world's greatest mystery, told for the first time by Patterson's own son and the people who were there.

movies.title: Trust Me, I'm a Doctor
movies.overview: The life of Dr. Sandeep Kapoor was turned upside down when he's implicated in the wrongful death trial of one-time Playboy centerfold Anna Nicole Smith.

movies.title: The Metropolitan Opera: Macbeth
movies.overview: Two of opera’s most extraordinary artists return to The Met: Live in HD for Verdi’s thrilling take on the immortal Shakespearean tale of the scheming couple determined to seize power at any cost. Following past triumphs in many of Verdi’s signature baritone roles, Quinn Kelsey is the Scottish king haunted by the ghosts of his murderous ascent to the throne, opposite Lise Davidsen—the world’s reigning dramatic soprano—as the power-mad Lady Macbeth, whose ruinous ambition damns them both. Met Music Director Yannick Nézet-Séguin takes the podium for a penetrating production by Louisa Proske, a brilliant young director making waves around the world. Rounding out the all-star cast are tenor Freddie De Tommaso as the heroic Macduff and bass-baritone Ryan Speedo Green as Macbeth’s friend-turned-victim Banquo. This live cinema transmission is part of The Met: Live in HD series, bringing opera to movie theaters across the globe.
Set in a medical college in a dread-stricken village, the film confronts the science behind superstitions, the superstitions in science, and an anomaly that neither can explain.

movies.title: Castration Movie Chapter iii. Junior Ghosts—Premorphic Drift; a fragmentary passage
movies.overview: Izzy does everything in her power to stop her partner from transitioning.

movies.title: Remember
movies.overview: An estranged couple who have forgotten what it means to love each other find themselves pretending to be together again for the sake of their daughter, whose memory is fading.

movies.title: Zi
movies.overview: In Hong Kong, a young woman haunted by visions of her future self meets a stranger who changes the course of her night -- and possibly her life.

movies.title: G.O.A.T
movies.overview: A small-time goon and his friends agree to stage a fake kidnapping for a bride-to-be in exchange for ransom money, but their plan backfires when their hostage proves more dominant than expected.

movies.title: The First Five Minutes... The Title Design Legacy of Dan Perri
movies.overview: An in-depth exploration into the life of Dan Perri, the man who created titles for some of the most iconic movies of all time.

movies.title: Quarter
movies.overview: Kelly, a young woman living with Type 1 diabetes, is about to turn 25, as she deals with the ups and downs of her blood sugar levels and the ups and downs of her personal life.

movies.title: Plucked
movies.overview: In Gilded Age New York, a rebellious woman seeking to divorce her emotionally unstable husband turns a seemingly civilised evening into a night of chaos and violence.

movies.title: Fallen Angels by Noël Coward
movies.overview: Two upper-class wives, their husbands away for the day, share a few toasts to their pre-marital dalliances—with the same man, who just may be en route from France to visit. Old rivalries and past scandals bubble to the surface in this intoxicating romp from one of theatre’s comedy masters.

movies.title: Alice in Wonderland –Dive in Wonderland–
movies.overview: The main character is a modern girl named Rise. One day, she wanders into Wonderland, and when she meets Alice, the story begins to unfold.

movies.title: A Christmas Prayer Tradition
movies.overview: Natalie prepares for the launch of her debut children’s book, Adeline the Angel, while Wes continues to deepen his faith journey. When Caroline quietly begins a mission to answer the prayers and needs of those around her community, the family discovers that some of God’s greatest works are accomplished through simple acts of kindness. As Christmas approaches, Bellford Falls once again becomes a place where hope is restored, prayers are answered, and hearts are drawn closer to the reason for the season.

movies.title: Bigg Homies
movies.overview: The whole hood respects Rodeen. His momma just wants him to get a job. Bigg Jah stars as the neighborhood's "Bigg Homie"—a man with plenty of street cred but no business giving life advice. When money meant to save his family's home gets stolen, Rodeen sets out to get it back.

movies.title: Bumpkin Soup
movies.overview: Country girl Akiko visits a Tokyo college in search of her hometown sweetheart. In the course of finding him, she runs into various odd inhabitants of the college campus–blasé intellectuals, horny co-eds, a psych professor in search of the theory of shame, and of course her beloved Yoshioka, who has become an elusive campus nobody.

movies.title: The Big Ashtray
movies.overview: In a closed room, a man who may be guilty of something terrible prepares for the arrival of an unknown figure who brings eternal rapture.

movies.title: The Sixty Year Mission: How Star Trek Changed Television and the World
movies.overview: This epic documentary reveals how bold artistic choices, behind-the-scenes conflicts, and groundbreaking ideas came together to create an enduring television classic. Through exclusive interviews and never-before-seen archival materials, The Sixty-Year Mission uncovers that truth is indeed stranger than science-fiction.

movies.title: Festive Fun with Peppa
movies.overview: Join Peppa Pig and her family as they celebrate baby Evie’s first Christmas. This festive cinema experience brings together seven classic festive-themed Peppa Pig episodes, new interstitial content, and four brand-new songs with music videos. From snowy adventures and festive plays to decorating the Christmas tree, Peppa and her family share treasured Christmas memories in this special big-screen experience.

movies.title: Brotherhood: A Cinematic Musical
movies.overview: "Brotherhood" tells the story of two next-door neighbors: Jon, a white US citizen, and Fabián, a Mexican immigrant who learn what it means to be American and to love your neighbor.

movies.title: The One
movies.overview: Hawk, a Native American ex-foster youth, who visits Enid, Oklahoma for the tallest Christmas tree lighting. He bonds with locals and runaway teen Alexis while dealing with PTSD, anxiety, and self-discovery concerning his faith.

movies.title: TOMORROW X TOGETHER WORLD TOUR 'ACT : TOMORROW'
movies.overview: Like shining stars, TOMORROW X TOGETHER’s fourth world tour 'ACT : TOMORROW' unfolds as a dazzling journey toward the tomorrow they promised together. From its beautiful storytelling to the stunning production and powerful live performances that captivated MOA around the world, experience the immersive energy of TOMORROW X TOGETHER’s spectacular world tour on the big screen!

movies.title: Paging Hezbollah
movies.overview: Paging Hezbollah is the extraordinary true story behind an intelligence operation that seemed impossible—how it was conceived, engineered and carried out, as well as the profound geopolitical consequences that followed.

movies.title: When a Witness Recants
movies.overview: In 1983, author Ta-Nehisi Coates learned that a 14-year-old boy was murdered in his Baltimore middle school. Upon revisiting the case, he uncovers the truth: Three innocent teenagers were wrongfully convicted and spent 36 years in prison — creating a lasting impact on the accused, the witnesses, and their community.

movies.title: California Schemin'
movies.overview: After being ridiculed for their Scottish accents, two ambitious musicians reinvent themselves as American rappers and fool the British music industry into a lucrative record deal, only for their elaborate lie to unravel under the weight of instant fame.

movies.title: Who Killed Alex Odeh?
movies.overview: In October 1985, Santa Ana, California was shaken by a brazen act of political violence when Palestinian American Alex Odeh, a beloved teacher and community leader, was killed by a tripwire bomb planted in his office. Despite substantial evidence and identified suspects, the case was never solved. Who Killed Alex Odeh? reopens the mystery, tracking a renewed investigation in real time as new leads emerge, long-buried records come to light, and the forces behind a political assassination are finally confronted.

movies.title: White Lightning
movies.overview: WHITE LIGHTNING is a gritty, funny, and uniquely American story about second chances, legacy, and what it takes to outrun your past. This feature-length documentary follows 18-year-old sprinter King Combest as he attempts to break his father’s 25-year-old national high school record–and the cycle of drugs, jail, and poverty that has shaped his Kentucky family for generations. King’s father Casey (aka “White Lightning”) was once an elite sprinter destined for Olympic greatness before a marijuana arrest derailed his career and left him working as a janitor on the margins of society. As King chases his father’s iconic record, it becomes clear that the real stakes are far greater: becoming the first man in the Combest family to earn a college degree and forging a path beyond a legacy of crime and addiction.

movies.title: Search Party: Where's PawPaw?
movies.overview: Noble Kristian Silk Williams rushes home after Aunt Meek Meek warns that PawPaw's health has taken a turn for the worse. After visiting him in a rundown nursing home, Noble and her quirky best friends return to find him missing. Joined by their chaotic, self-reformed hood-Aunty, they follow bizarre clues and encounter eccentric characters in a race to find PawPaw before time runs out.

movies.title: Morbid Weekend
movies.overview: A pizza delivery person dies on the job and a series of strange events follow.

movies.title: The Dreamed Adventure
movies.overview: Journeying home to the Bulgarian hinterlands on the border of Turkey and Greece, Saïd seeks out a fuel-smuggling deal with a small-time crook, attracting the attention of Iliya, the local kingpin. Sensing danger, Saïd enlists the help of one-time romantic interest Veska, an archaeologist who years earlier had fallen in with the swindlers and operators of the post-Communist era. But when Saïd goes missing, Veska takes over the smuggling operation, deftly moving among the thunderous, posturing men and coming-face-to-face with the underworld that shaped her past.

movies.title: Batulo Jun
movies.overview: Abhiman, freshly graduated and recruited for a government job, returns to his village. Seeing his villagers struggling with basic literacy, he chooses to stay and contribute, eventually falling in love with Jun— unaware that fate will test their relationship.

movies.title: Titans
movies.overview: Small-time gangster Antony Yakuza teams up with young programmer Anwar to pull off a major heist, with mysterious driver Rejimon joining them. But Rejimon is not who he seems, and their simple crime soon turns into a strange, unpredictable journey where reality itself begins to blur.

movies.title: Lady Liberty: Secrets of an Icon
movies.overview: This iconic statue was a gift from France to the new-born American Republic and was the first crowd-funded monument of all time. A symbol of emancipation and freedom, which took two decades to be completed. The film features original 3D virtual reconstitutions of Auguste Bartholdi’s Atelier in Paris and travels back in time to bring viewers at the heart of the Statue’s original construction, revealing the founding ideals of our democracies.

movies.title: The Eyes of Ghana
movies.overview: 93-year-old documentarian Chris Hesse—personal cinematographer to forgotten African icon Kwame Nkrumah—races against blindness and time to rescue and repatriate a secret trove of over 1,300 films that captured the birth of African independence in the fifties and sixties. Yet unseen by the public, these films may not only rewrite Ghanaian and African history—but world history itself.

movies.title: Summer Holidays
movies.overview: A city boy's summer at his grandparents' Godavari village transforms when he befriends a spirited local paper boy. Together they explore rural life through adventures that forge an unforgettable childhood bond.

movies.title: The Girl with the Leica
movies.overview: On Bastille Day in 1937, pioneering German-Jewish photojournalist Gerda Taro spends her final day in Paris confronting her past, her complex partnership with Robert Capa, and her absolute commitment to anti-fascist resistance before returning to the front lines of the Spanish Civil War.

movies.title: The Renaissance of Oddity Todd
movies.overview: In a world ruled by the authoritarian World Collective, the secretive Sonus master the power of vibration. When a deeper evil emerges, only a Sonus with a cryptic past can save humanity from a dark reckoning.

movies.title: Kabaddi 5: After the Final Match
movies.overview: As Kaji steps into a new chapter of his life, familiar faces return while new characters enter his world, each bringing their own motives, desires, and complications. With new dreams and new responsibilities, Kaji finds himself facing challenges he never expected.

movies.title: #Vymara
movies.overview: Four washed-up creators livestream their search for a missing YouTuber linked to a conspiracy and uncover a sinister truth never meant to go viral.

movies.title: André Leon Talley — Style is Forever
movies.overview: André Leon Talley was a trailblazing fashion icon whose influence spanned nearly five decades. This documentary explores his legacy of inclusivity, elegance, and the fearless pursuit of authenticity. Interviews with Anna Wintour, Tom Ford and Diane von Furstenberg, among others, as well as never-before-seen footage, reveal Talley’s personal and professional challenges and remarkable triumphs.

movies.title: Miss Representation: Rise Up
movies.overview: MISS REPRESENTATION: RISING dives deep into the cultural backlash against women’s mental health, agency, and political power with technology exacerbating sexism and misogyny towards women and girls.

movies.title: Sending Spree
movies.overview: Michaela Kiersch goes on a global sending spree, becoming the first woman ever to climb both V15 boulders and 5.15 routes.

movies.title: One Eye Open
movies.overview: A recent college graduate house-sitting for her ailing grandfather finds herself caught in a deadly cat-and-mouse game with thieves who become haunted by something supernatural protecting her in the mysterious mansion.

movies.title: The Infinite
movies.overview: Charlie Donovan, on the brink of losing everything he loves, is drawn into a fateful journey with seven strange strangers, each of whom holds a key to save him from self-destruction.

movies.title: My Undesirable Friends: Part II - Exile
movies.overview: A group of Russian independent journalists flee the country and navigate life in exile after the invasion of Ukraine, focusing on their dispersed lives and ongoing struggle for truth across different nations. While Part I documented their lives in Moscow facing mounting pressure from the Putin regime, Part II chronicles their forced displacement and new realities in various countries, continuing their mission against authoritarianism.

movies.title: Going for Two
movies.overview: In the fall of 1983, as their beloved college football team vies for the National Championship, a fatherless 12-year-old boy and his tomboy neighbor embark on a quest for his 'manhood'.

movies.title: Alone on the Torre
movies.overview: Elite alpinist Colin Haley lays everything on the line in a legendary winter solo push on Cerro Torre – one of Patagonia’s most iconic and unforgiving peaks

movies.title: Christmas Pop-Up
movies.overview: Desperate for a fresh start, an unlucky-in-love set decorator takes a job designing a Christmas Eve pop-up event for a jaded celebrity chef, hoping to escape her current hell - living with her ex and his new girlfriend - before they get engaged on New Year’s Eve.

movies.title: In Transit
movies.overview: When a complacent young bartender living in small-town Maine agrees to model for a existentially floundering painter on an artist's retreat, both women must confront their preconceptions of what makes a good life.

movies.title: The Fish Don't Care When It Rains
movies.overview: How far would you go to change a child the world can’t understand? One autistic artist survives a hidden system of abuse built to correct her.

movies.title: A Good Hand Wasted
movies.overview: A luxury island getaway turns deadly when six friends join a mysterious dealer's poker game, where every losing hand means a round of Russian roulette.

movies.title: What Lives in Room 214?
movies.overview: "What Lives in Room 214?" is a psychological horror featurette that follows actor Cory King who moves into a hotel for semi-successful actors, producers, and directors. The longer he stays, the more he notices things around him have never been what they seemed. "What Lives in Room 214?" tells a cautionary tale about the cost of fame.

movies.title: When Wine Meets Coffee
movies.overview: When Claire, a sophisticated wine expert, travels to Costa Rica, her carefully ordered world collides with Alex, a passionate coffee producer deeply rooted in his family’s land. As wine and coffee, past and present, begin to intertwine, an unexpected connection challenges what they thought they knew about love, memory, and the paths that bring people together.

movies.title: Parasites
movies.overview: When two families vacation in paradise, an alien parasite crashes into their world, infecting the locals and unleashing chaos. As reality unravels, survival means facing what's inside - and what's coming. For fans of 'A Quiet Place'.

movies.title: Chha Maya Chhapakkai 2
movies.overview: An aging political comrade leaves his career behind for marriage, only to find himself trapped in a chaotic, comical bind between two women and the bitter grudges of opposing political families.

movies.title: Terrestrial
movies.overview: A reunion weekend spirals out of control for four college friends when the host - a science fiction writer on the verge of newfound success - fights to maintain his sense of reality in the face of sudden, uncanny dangers.

movies.title: Grandmasters
movies.overview: The once esoteric and uninspired world of competitive chess is thrown into turmoil when an eccentric German entrepreneur enlists reigning champion Magnus Carlsen to launch a new league that aims to revolutionize the game, challenge the sport's governing body, and "make chess cool."

movies.title: American Amazon
movies.overview: A spectacular journey through natural wonders of a part of the country Grammy-winning musician and actor Jon Batiste knows very well: the vast network of wetlands spanning Alabama, Florida, Georgia, Louisiana, and the Carolinas.

movies.title: When Angels Fall
movies.overview: Inspired by true events, WHEN ANGELS FALL tells the story of a young and talented actress that becomes the 'Darling of Tinseltown' to only become discarded and cast-out. While at her lowest point, a divine encounter with someone not of this world helps her begin to see herself for who she truly is.

movies.title: Paul and Greg and Amelia
movies.overview: A novelist struggling with writer's block interviews his wealthy estranged college roommate and his wife, where an old secret threatens all of their safety.

movies.title: Get Into The Spirit
movies.overview: While attempting to communicate with a handsome ghost haunting their house, two husbands discover there are many ways a spirit can reach out from beyond the grave.

movies.title: Rise and Shine
movies.overview: Terri Steele has waited her whole life for high school. She wants what every teenager wants: new friends, a beautiful dress, a date to prom and the chance to be seen for exactly who she is. Her mother, Janice, has spent Terri’s whole life helping her believe the world can make room for her. Now they must discover what it means to let go, grow up and step into a new day.

movies.title: Kikuyu Land
movies.overview: As a Nairobi journalist probes a land battle entangling the local government and a powerful multinational corporation, covered wounds are revealed and family secrets are exposed.

movies.title: Why I Am an Anarchist
movies.overview: In the wealthy suburbs of Arizona, an animal-rights extremist has her ideology thrown into a tailspin when she meets an unhoused teenager in the desert behind her school.

movies.title: Urgent Care
movies.overview: A doctor is working her final night at an urgent care clinic that's about to close down when she finds herself confronted by a patient who seems to be possessed by a demon.

movies.title: The Jesus Tapes
movies.overview: Jesus returns to a disturbed, distracted world and is interviewed on a public access TV show.

movies.title: VIEWFINDER
movies.overview: Evil is in the eye of the beholder.

movies.title: Hold on to Your Music - A Mother's Legacy
movies.overview: Three generations of Jewish women bound by music and trauma navigate the legacy of the Holocaust, from Vienna to London to Los Angeles, in a quest for redemption.

movies.title: Hold On, Pain Ends
movies.overview: Ben Mayforth redefines adaptive climbing in his intense pursuit of 5.13.

movies.title: Grow
movies.overview: After his girlfriend dies, a grieving man awakens impossibly pregnant and becomes the captive of her fanatical family, who will stop at nothing to see the child born.

movies.title: Annapurna: Dreams and Nightmares
movies.overview: Annapurna: Dreams and Nightmares is a 2026 documentary film by Thin Air Cinematics that challenges the traditional "man-conquers-mountain" story by exploring high-altitude mountaineering through failure, fear and human obsession  Filmed over 13 years, spanning 6 expeditions on 5 different climbing routes, this deeply personal documentary is an unflinching exploration into the life and mind of a high-altitude climber.  What begins with a dream becomes obsession, and ultimately a reckoning with why we climb in the first place.

movies.title: Simon. The Conqueror!
movies.overview: The world's greatest detective enters into the town of New Babel. Only to be faced with a grand mystery that only he could conquer... Maybe.

movies.title: Pension Patta
movies.overview: After his father’s death, Rajan and his mother, Chalu, struggle to claim his pension and repay his debts. A search for a missing name leads Rajan on a journey that transforms him from a greedy young man into a generous one.

movies.title: Transylvania Tapes
movies.overview: In 1997, Romanian actress Silvia Enescu mysteriously disappeared while searching for family property in Transylvania. All she left behind were a collection of home movies: the TRANSYLVANIA TAPES. Now, Silvia's daughter Mara travels from Los Angeles to Romania to discover what happened to her mother. With the help of her cameraman friend Dylan, Mara documents her journey, which takes her from the streets of Bucharest to the medieval town of Sighisoara, deep in the heart of Transylvania. Unearthing the truth about her mother comes at a terrible price, as Mara must escape an ancient family curse.

movies.title: Drinking and Driving
movies.overview: Early twenties Iris and Palmer never left their hometown. They work at the same restaurant, share the same bed, and both have a habit of drinking and driving. They run into Levi, a guy they used to know. They spend time with him and his cousin, Phoenix, in cars, backyards, and other people’s bedrooms. When Levi shares a dream he had with Iris things change between the four of them. The reality of the summer becomes faded, the parties die. The four end in a field of unified confusion.

movies.title: Baa: Ek Yoddha
movies.overview: The silent struggles, scarifies, and unconditional love of a father.

movies.title: A. Rimbaud
movies.overview: Follows French writer Arthur Rimbaud from his schoolboy days in Charleville to his final years in Africa.

movies.title: Beyond The Eagle Obsession
movies.overview: A companion to "The Eagle Obsession", "Beyond the Eagle Obsession: 50 Years of Fandom” spotlights the passionate collectors, artists, model builders, and fans who have kept the legacy of the Eagle spacecraft alive for half a century.

movies.title: Gentle by Birth
movies.overview: After her 23-year-old brother dies of an overdose, filmmaker Doree Simon Hatfield investigates the stigma she believes blocked his access to treatment and support. Her search takes her from her family’s living room to harm reduction sites, music festivals, and the halls of the Pennsylvania Capitol, where she meets experts working to change how addiction is understood and treated. But as her own fear and stigma around drugs begin to dissolve, Doree makes a radical choice to try them herself—transforming the film from a dissection of her brother’s addiction into a provocative reckoning that threatens her family’s fragile healing.

movies.title: Last Night at the Alamo
movies.overview: A canceled Hollywood actor travels to Pittsburgh in an attempt to revive his career and ends up involved with a group of wannabe left-wing terrorists.

movies.title: Faraway Home
movies.overview: Two young Jewish children are sent by their parents away from Nazi occupied Austria during WWII, on the Kindertransport, where they end up at a refugee farm in Northern Ireland.

movies.title: The North
movies.overview: A decade after they were best friends and roommates, Chris and Lluis set out on a 600 kilometer hike through the Scottish Highlands to reconnect with each other, nature and parts of themselves they lost.

movies.title: Flat Earth
movies.overview: After years of obsessive research, a brilliant but isolated physicist succeeds in creating the world's first artificial black hole inside a secret laboratory. Instead of unlocking the secrets of gravity, the experiment tears open reality itself, revealing an impossible truth: the world is not a globe, but one of countless vast, layered planes stacked beyond human perception.

movies.title: 58th
movies.overview: Fifteen years after the Maguindanao Massacre, the family of its 58th victim fights for the justice that remains elusive.

movies.title: Stellar Romance
movies.overview: Their first meeting transforms an extraordinary space expedition into an unforgettable love story. As they explore strange planets, witness the birth of stars, and uncover secrets hidden within the fabric of time, their love begins to challenge the laws of the universe itself.  But their relationship faces an impossible choice: save the woman he loves, preserve the future of an entire civilization, or risk changing the destiny of the cosmos forever.  Can love survive across galaxies, dimensions, and time itself?  Somewhere among the stars, two souls may discover that love is the most powerful force in the universe.

movies.title: Nurse: Empathy Heals
movies.overview: While people may think they know what nurses do, this documentary reveals the emotional challenges nurses face on a daily basis when caring for patients. These are nurses’ stories about compassion and empathy, the grief that doesn’t disappear, and the catharsis that comes from being heard. Through these personal stories, revealing the moments of doubt, faith, grief, joy, and fierce love that shape every act of care, the film celebrates nurses as the heroes they truly are.

movies.title: The Marshmallow Ghosts presents Corpse Reviver No. 3: Possessions
movies.overview: When Nathan receives a call from an estate-sale dealer who has discovered a box of mysterious tapes bearing ominous handwritten labels, he agrees to come pick them up.  What begins as a simple errand becomes a journey through the forgotten corners of the region. Over the course of a single day, Nathan drives from one location to another, listening to the tapes as an unseen narrator recounts the strange histories and folk stories connected to each place. As each story unfolds, the soundtrack changes with it, turning the landscape itself into a series of haunted tableaux scored by The Marshmallow Ghosts.

movies.title: Matty Ryan: Live in Chicago
movies.overview: Matty Ryan has shares stories about being too high for 7-11, billionaires stealing blood from their teen sons, how mummies started COVID, and much more. He turns small annoyances into big laughs, rides the line between chaos and charm.

movies.title: The Wait

movies.title: Diaspora Power
movies.overview: Inspired by the stories of Haitian women and men who arrived in Quebec during the 1960s and 1970s, Diaspora Power, directed by Joseph Hillel, traces a generation navigating exile, migration, and the challenges of building a new home.  Through intimate personal stories, the documentary explores the realities of integration and systemic racism alongside the solidarity, community networks, and cultural connections that sustained Haitian immigrants as they established new lives in Quebec. Together, these individual experiences form a collective portrait of a diaspora determined to maintain its roots while becoming an integral part of Quebec society.  Diaspora Power is both an act of remembrance and transmission, honoring the people whose lives, labor, and resilience helped shape the social and cultural fabric of contemporary Quebec.

movies.title: Little Guayule: The Lost Manzanar Rubber Project
movies.overview: Guayule, a plant native to the desert Southwest, is a natural source of non-latex rubber. During World War II, the Japanese Empire’s occupation of much of Southeast Asia meant that the Allies lost access to major sources of natural rubber.  In a remarkable story of skill, resilience, and ingenuity, Japanese Americans incarcerated at Manzanar and elsewhere worked to cultivate guayule and dramatically improve methods for extracting rubber from the plant. Little Guayule: The Lost Manzanar Rubber Project helps bring this little-known chapter of Manzanar history to light.

movies.title: Where Do Black Men Live?
movies.overview: Where Do Black Men Live? explores the experiences of low-income and housing-insecure Black men in Cambridge, Massachusetts, amplifying voices too often excluded from conversations about housing, urban policy, and racial justice. Produced by The Black Response and based on 25 ethnographic interviews conducted by Haitian sociologist Stephanie Guirand for her doctoral research, the film uses a verbatim theatre approach, with its dialogue drawn directly from the words of the men interviewed. Eight men, portrayed by actors, are brought together in an imagined circle where they share deeply personal experiences of searching for, securing, and maintaining a place to call home. Directed by Corinne Spencer, with co-directors Gift Tapiwa Marovatsanga and Joy Wrolson, Where Do Black Men Live? transforms research and lived testimony into an intimate exploration of housing insecurity, systemic racism, resilience, and the fundamental question of who gets to feel secure and at home.
movies.director: Corinne Spencer, Gift Tapiwa Marovatsanga, Joy Wrolson

movies.title: The Undiscovered Country

movies.title: Watsky x Infinity

movies.title: Half Order
movies.overview: Filmed and directed by Eric “Remrod” Mayes and co written by Warren Armour, the film dives into the world of St. Louis style fried rice, neighborhood chop sueys, St. Paul sandwiches, and Vess sodas while uncovering the traditions that shaped generations across the city.  Through raw conversations, cinematic storytelling, and an original soundtrack, HALF ORDER explores identity, nostalgia, and the cultural connections built through shared neighborhood experiences. More than a documentary about Chinese food, HALF ORDER is a heartfelt portrait of St. Louis, its people, and the culture that continues to connect them.

movies.title: The Gift (Fantaisie-Impromptu)

In the wake of her mother's sudden passing, Abigail finds solace and purpose in music, and her natural talent quickly blossoms. Recognizing her exceptional gift, her father sends her to Paris to pursue a career as a concert pianist. Meanwhile, he begins his own investigation into the piano's mysterious origins. As he uncovers a hidden history of loss, longing, and silent lives quietly touched by the instrument, Abigail's fame begins to grow, along with the weight of the secret behind her talent.

movies.title: Where the Fear Ends
movies.overview: In 1976 a small group of women in Montgomery County, PA sat together around a kitchen table to discuss the Women’s Movement. They were aware of women wanting to enter the workforce, go to college, and create ways to balance all of it with their roles as wives and mothers. They thought it might be a good idea to set up a women’s resource group and have a place that women could come to discuss ideas and receive support. Then the hotline started ringing. Volunteers answered the calls. And the calls kept coming. The majority of calls were from women sharing that they were being abused by their partners and they needed help. The Volunteers were shocked and sprang into action to build an organization that addressed the needs of domestic violence victims.  Fifty years later the Women's Center of Montgomery County has grown into a thriving organization with seven offices and more than 150 Volunteers and one of the most effective domestic violence organizations in the country.

movies.overview: When Santa forgets the true meaning of Christmas, he finds himself in the heart of a lively mall community in desperate need of his help. Sapped of his magic, he’ll need another way to take on the goons threatening the mall, and time is running out. Santa has to rediscover his faith in goodness and call in some last-minute reinforcements from the one person no baddie wants to tangle with: Mrs. Claus.

movies.title: Behemoth!
movies.overview: Gifted cellist Alex Serian returns home to Los Angeles after 20 years on the road. Music, which has been the constant, all-consuming river of his life, begins to carry Alex on an adventure that will change him forever.

movies.title: Minotaur
movies.overview: When Gleb, a successful company director, finds himself under siege from mounting corporate pressures, an increasingly unstable world, and the discovery of his wife's affair, the collapse of his carefully ordered life accelerates toward violence.

movies.title: Ray Gunn
movies.overview: In Metropia, a gigantic city in an alternate future as seen from 1939, private eye Raymond Gunn is drawn into a case involving aliens, murder and a multimedia star named Venus Nova.

movies.title: Flavia
movies.overview: The adventures of 11-year-old Flavia de Luce, who is both an amateur detective and a master poisoner. When she discovers a dead body in her family’s decaying British manor house and her father is accused of the murder, Flavia launches her own investigation to uncover family secrets and bring the true murderer to justice.

movies.title: Elsinore
movies.overview: The deeply emotional and inspirational true story of Ian Charleson, a gifted actor whose greatest challenge becomes his greatest triumph. Facing his own mortality with unflinching honesty, wit, and grace, Charleson delivers a courageous performance that becomes a source of healing and inspiration for those around him.

movies.title: Steps
movies.overview: Think you know Cinderella's 'evil' stepsisters? Think again! When misunderstood Lilith is blamed for hijacking the Royal Ball with a stolen magic wand, she accidentally turns her sister Margot into a frog and leaves the kingdom in the hands of a prince-obsessed mean girl. Now Lilith must team up with Cinderella — and a surprisingly dreamy troll — to save the kingdom, repair the fractured fairytale, and prove that even so-called villains deserve a shot at happily-ever-after.

movies.title: Peppa Pig: Perfect Holiday
movies.overview: Peppa is disappointed when she learns her family vacation is canceled. However, a sudden storm blows a hot air balloon carrying Peppa, George, Granny Pig, and Grandpa Pig all the way to China

movies.title: The Muppets
movies.overview: When Kermit the Frog and the Muppets learn that their beloved theater is slated for demolition, a sympathetic human, Gary, and his felt-faced brother, Walter, swoop in to help the gang put on a telethon show and raise the $10 million they need to save the day.

movies.title: Josephine
movies.overview: After eight-year-old Josephine accidentally witnesses a brutal assault, she begins acting out violently to protect herself. This emotional trauma leads to conflicts between her parents as they search for justice and a way to feel safe again.

movies.title: The Gallerist
movies.overview: A desperate gallerist conspires to sell a dead body at Art Basel Miami.

movies.title: Hershey
movies.overview: Based on the life of Milton Hershey, founder of the iconic Hershey chocolate company. Milton's grit and determination to conquer the world of candy-making propel him from bankruptcy to monumental success, and the love of his life, Kitty, helps him build a legacy sweeter than any candy bar. But when Kitty falls ill, Milton’s wild optimism teeters on the edge of destruction, and she sparks an even bolder dream: to leave their fortune in the hands of America’s children in need.

movies.title: Tangles
movies.overview: A young woman is forced to return to the conservative small town where her bizarre family lives to take care of her mother, having to deal with the cruel reality of her mom's Alzheimer disease and become the daughter they need.

movies.title: The Fox
movies.overview: An affable foxhunter encounters a talking Fox who offers him an opportunity to transform his fiancée into the perfect woman.

movies.title: Above the Below
movies.overview: Three astronauts survive a violently destructive re-entry, only to discover their landing capsule is sinking into the uncharted depths of the ocean. Completely cut off from the world, they must battle both the sea and their isolation to survive.

movies.title: Lilo & Scratch
movies.overview: Stitch is tasked with looking after Scratch, a cat Lilo has found, but Scratch has more similarities with Stitch than meets the eye.

movies.title: November 1963
movies.overview: Follows the 48 hours after the assassination of President John F. Kennedy, the alleged involvement of Sam Giancana and the 'Chicago Outfit', and a supposed broken promise after the mob helped to get Kennedy elected.

movies.title: Tender Loving Care
movies.overview: Amy, a government child protection worker, moves back with her upbeat best friend Rosie, a social services officer facing daily anger and resentment. Amy's aging parents worry about her happiness while dealing with their own crisis.

movies.title: In Waves
movies.overview: In Los Angeles, shy teenager AJ meets Kristen, who lives for surfing; he loves skateboarding and drawing. They fall madly in love, and a happy future seems within reach. But everything changes when Kristen faces a sudden illness. Together, they face adversity, driven by the strength of their love, their friends, and their newly shared passion for surfing and the ocean.

movies.title: The Vile
movies.overview: Devoted wife and mother Amani, whose life begins to unravel when her husband returns home with a second wife and an unseen darkness infiltrates her life.

movies.title: Cameron Winter at Carnegie Hall
movies.overview: A concert film documenting Cameron Winter's sold-out performance at Carnegie Hall.

movies.title: Ben'Imana
movies.overview: Rwanda, 2012. The country is emerging from an era of silence after the 1994 Tutsi genocide, and people's courts are being set up with the aim of bringing justice and reconciliation. Veneranda, a survivor, is convinced of the need for these trials. Despite pressures, she organises discussion sessions between victims and the families of the executioners. Therapy for some, an act of betrayal for others, these testimonial sessions revive and reveal the traumas that each of them try to overcome, in their own way. The wounds of Veneranda's past are exposed again when she learns of her daughter's unexpected pregnancy and the identity of the father. Veneranda has to face her own contradictions and the dark parts of her past.

movies.title: ENE Repeat
movies.overview: A close-knit group of friends embark on another unforgettable journey, where old memories, new adventures, and unexpected twists test their friendship.

movies.title: A Long Winter
movies.overview: After his mother disappears during the first blizzard of the season, a young man refuses to give up hope as one long Colorado winter reshapes his relationship with his father and his understanding of the man he is becoming.

movies.title: Eternal Return
movies.overview: Cass has come to a personal point of emotional invulnerability, until she meets Virgil, a cartographer. Along with his partner Malcolm, they attempt to travel back in time to awaken Cass to love again.

movies.title: The Friend's House is Here
movies.overview: In Tehran’s underground art scene, Pari, a theater director, and Hanna, a dancer, are roommates, best friends, actors, and professional partners, navigating rehearsals, performances, and the quiet rituals of everyday life—until their secret circle is discovered. Shot covertly but far removed from familiar portrayals of Iran, directors Maryam Ataei and Hossein Keshavarz blur the boundaries between theatrical performance and lived experience, crafting a luminous portrait of sisterhood where art becomes inseparable from life and even the smallest creative choices can become acts of resistance.

movies.title: Dark Noon
movies.overview: Caught in a cycle of petty crime and imprisonment, a man is released from prison for a failed bank robbery attempt while an impending solar eclipse offers a way out of the cycle.

movies.title: Mysaa
movies.overview: Unafraid of war and unwilling to stop until she finds that one answer. She carries no doubts. Only the ache of an answer she's searched her whole life.

movies.title: 14th
movies.overview: Revolves around the equal protection and citizenship-focused 14th amendment, which was ratified in 1868 in the turbulent era of Reconstruction and has been a contentious part of the American body politic ever since.

movies.title: Gods Don't Give Gifts
movies.overview: "Gods Don't Give Gifts" traces the fallout of humanity besting earthly limitations like death and memory through technology and how it grapples with humanity as a result.

movies.title: The Magnificent Raiders of Dimension War One
movies.overview: A collection of rogues must gather information on a mysterious extra-dimensional threat to the galaxy in the 43rd century, and prepare a defense while fending off the first wave of attacks from horrific beings.

movies.title: A Fox Under a Pink Moon
movies.overview: At just 16, Soraya is already creating stunning drawings and sculptures that are as beautiful as they are dark. This strong-willed Afghan sculptor and illustrator has been trying for five years to escape Iran and join her mother in Austria.

movies.title: Ash and Crayons
movies.overview: Seven Ukrainian children demonstrate resilience while facing catastrophic injuries and forcible deportations during the ongoing war, their stories told through verité footage and animation by Ukrainian artists.

movies.title: Alias Rukmini
movies.overview: Krishna writes edgy and raunchy books under his wife Rukmini's name as a pseudonym, concealing his identity as the true author behind the provocative novels.

movies.title: The Test
movies.overview: Caught between a pro bono murder investigation and a law school reunion, Mike Leonardo reconnects with classmates for a weekend to celebrate the past. But when buried secrets surface the reunion curdles into something far more dangerous.

movies.title: Demon Dancer: Sua/Nara
movies.overview: After tragedy shatters her life, a professional ballerina allows a demon to possess her—transforming her body, movement, and rage into a deadly weapon.

movies.title: Who Is Still Alive
movies.overview: A map of Gaza, its towns, camps and neighbourhoods. White paint on a black ground. Within the crudely drawn outlines, nine refugees who escaped the inferno tell their stories.

movies.title: Transplant
movies.overview: A motivated surgical resident pushes himself to extreme lengths while training under a legendary heart transplant surgeon who's obsessed with protecting his perfect reputation.

movies.title: UK Holiday
movies.overview: A UK Holiday is not just a journey; it’s an adventure filled with love, laughter, and unforgettable memories. The story revolves around Aakash, a kind-hearted and adventurous young man, who invites his sister Rekha from the USA to visit the UK for a long-awaited family reunion. Rekha, excited to escape her routine, is thrilled to meet their mother, Subhadra, and sisters Priyanka and Deepika, who already reside in the UK. Aakash ensures this holiday becomes a truly special experience. Together, they explore London’s iconic landmarks like the London Eye and Tower Bridge. The journey takes them to the natural wonder of Durdle Door in Dorset and the charming town of Aldershot. Along the way, they share stories, laughter, and moments of deep connection. This feature film captures the essence of holidays—taking a break, reconnecting with loved ones, and creating memories that last a lifetime. UK Holiday is a celebration of family, adventure, and the joy of togetherness.

movies.title: Errand Guy
movies.overview: Brad, a middle-aged errand runner, gets guilt-tripped by his dead Jewish Grandmother into believing his passive life embarrasses his ancestors, so he steals a Ferrari and tries to buy a minor league baseball team behind his wife's back.

movies.title: The Wonderful Wizard Of Ha's
movies.overview: When a cosmic warp strikes a commuter tracks, a stylish teenager named Dorthy Ross ( Soroya Clayton-Wright) and her trusty dog poodle Smarty  are transported from the ordinary world straight into Stardust City—a glittering, neon-lit fantasy metropolis. Arriving in style aboard a custom-built, purple clockwork locomotive, she is greeted by the glamorous The Good Witch of the South ( Joh'Vonnie Monroe ), who welcomes her with a show-stopping musical number.  But the party is short-lived. Armed with a pink shirt, a purple poodle skirt, and a magical pair of silver slippers, the young trendsetter must navigate the dangers of the Yellow Brick Road after the Wicked Witch crashes the celebration. Packed with high-fashion aesthetics, explosive blue-diamond wand fireworks, and a soulful, show-stopping soundtrack, The Wonderful Wizard of Ha's is a bold, comedic, and modern reimagining of L. Frank Baum’s classic 1900 tale.

movies.title: XI: Thou Shalt Not Be Indifferent
movies.overview: Marian Turski, the world-renowned historian, journalist, and until his recent passing, president of the International Auschwitz Committee, takes us back to the roots of evil. A survivor of the Lodz Ghetto, Auschwitz, Buchenwald, and Theresienstadt death camps in his youth, Turski explains with firsthand knowledge and surgical precision how otherwise well-educated and cultured people can, under certain circumstances, turn into criminals and mass murderers. He reminds us about the painful past, explains the present, and warns about the future. His dramatic plea, "do not be indifferent!" remains more relevant now than ever. Andrzej Wolf, the director and cinematographer of this film, pays a loving tribute to one of the last moral compasses of the Greatest Generation.

movies.title: Ka Kaa Ki Kii
movies.overview: Weary of years of neglect, a band of four complete misfits unwillingly teams up to save their village and loved ones. What ensues is absolute madness, chaos, and a riot of laughter as they defy the odds while discovering compassion, forgiveness, and friendship along the way.

movies.title: BTS WORLD TOUR 'ARIRANG' IN KAOHSIUNG: LIVE VIEWING
movies.overview: The record-breaking journey continues as BTS’s history-making tour across Asia makes its way to the big screen. Join the roar of the crowds in Kaohsiung in November and experience the breathtaking performances and electrifying energy of BTS’s stadium tour. Don't miss your chance to witness BTS WORLD TOUR 'ARIRANG' in all its glory in cinemas worldwide.

movies.title: Precipice
movies.overview: A profoundly working-class community with an intense connection to its land and water is transformed into a pleasure paradise for the wealthy…all while the ground slips into the sea. A feature documentary, PRECIPICE focuses on the intersection between climate change and a changing shore community’s response to this global emergency.

movies.title: Games We Play
movies.overview: Imogen accompanies her boyfriend Jack and his two childhood best friends on a weekend getaway. There, she must participate in a tournament of high-stakes games, leading her to question her sanity and her safety.

movies.title: The Tragedy of the Bernalillo County Detectives
movies.overview: 1979. An intense conspiracy unfolds after the robbery of a legendary fortune.

movies.title: Vive le Punk
movies.overview: 50 years after the British Punk explosion, this documentary follows four bands that are still active today (Sham 69, 999, Ruts DC and The Boys) and features interviews with Charlie Harper, Joe Corre, Dr. John Cooper Clarke, Gaye Advert and other Punk Rock luminaries in search for the meaning of Punk and the relevance of its message today.  With rare archival footage, explosive live performances, and an unflinching look at the punk ethos in today’s world, this film is not just a retrospective—In a world that mirrors the one Punk once railed against, is the message still relevant—or has it been consumed by commercialism?. This film should appeal to every generation of rebels, misfits, and outsiders. Punk may have started as anarchy in the streets, but it’s far from finished. Vive le Punk!

movies.title: A Dot in the Ocean
movies.overview: A Dot in the Ocean is a gripping documentary that transports viewers to the breathtaking, vibrant shores of Utila, Honduras - until an astonishing discovery deep within the mangroves changes everything, leaving audiences questioning what lies hidden just out of sight.

movies.title: Avengers: Doomsday
movies.overview: Beloved heroes from three distinct universes are set on a deadly collision course and face an existential threat unlike anything they've ever encountered.

movies.title: Puella Magi Madoka Magica the Movie -Walpurgisnacht: Rising-
movies.overview: After the events of Rebellion, the world appears to be in balance—but that peace is fragile. As a new threat connected to Walpurgisnacht emerges, Homura Akemi is forced to face the consequences of her choices and question how far she is willing to go to protect Madoka.

collection.name: Puella Magi Madoka Magica: The Movie Collection

movies.title: Dune: Part Three
movies.overview: Nearly two decades after he seized control of the Imperium, Paul Atreides is now a ruthless Emperor, and must face the consequences of his reign as old allies return, terrifying new threats emerge, and betrayal lurks in every shadow. Haunted by visions of Imperial collapse and the reappearance of his long-lost love, Paul is drawn into a sweeping conspiracy, with Chani at the heart of its unfolding mystery. As enemies close in, Paul must confront the true cost of power and the fate of those he loves the most.

movies.title: The Prestige
movies.overview: A mysterious story of two magicians whose intense rivalry leads them on a life-long battle for supremacy -- full of obsession, deceit and jealousy with dangerous and deadly consequences.

movies.title: Jumanji: Open World
movies.overview: Our heroes have escaped the ever-changing jungles of Jumanji before, but this time the game comes to us—as Jumanji breaks free of its console, unleashing its chaos into our world.

movies.title: The Angry Birds Movie 3
movies.overview: Red faces his greatest challenge yet—surviving fatherhood… while saving the world.

movies.title: The Holiday
movies.overview: Two women, one American and one British, swap homes at Christmastime following bad breakups. Each woman finds romance with a local man but realizes that the imminent return home may end the relationship.

movies.title: Ice Age: Boiling Point
movies.overview: A dinosaur-and-lava-filled madcap adventure takes Manny, Sid, Diego, Ellie, Buck, acorn-obsessed Scrat – this time joined by Baby Scrat and the enormous Jurassic Scrat – and the rest of the herd to visit never before-seen corners of the treacherous Lost World.

movies.title: Coward
movies.overview: Surrounded by brutality but bound by a tender intimacy, two World War I soldiers find a fragile sanctuary of love and art amid the shadows of the Belgian trenches.

movies.title: The Beekeeper 2
movies.overview: Pulled back into the fight when the Beekeeper organization goes rogue and sets its sights on controlling the government, Clay must take on the very group that made him.

movies.title: The Debut
movies.overview: When Mona Friedman is cast in a bit part at a small community theater, she transforms from a shy, unassuming housewife into a zealous method actor willing to do anything to protect the artistic integrity of her marginal role—even if it means waging war against the show’s domineering director.

movies.title: Karōshi
movies.overview: In a near-future Manhattan corporate loyalty and cultural tradition have reshaped everyday life. When a mysterious outsider infiltrates a powerful company after a worker's death, he exposes the violent system hidden beneath its polished surface.

movies.title: Werwulf
movies.overview: A harrowing tale of devotion, damnation and the devil within.

movies.title: La Gradiva
movies.overview: Amid the ancient ruins of Pompeii, a group of French teenagers on a class trip to Naples grapple with anxiety and exhilaration ahead of their high school graduation.

movies.title: Lords of War
movies.overview: Yuri Orlov, the world's most famous arms dealer, discovers that he has a son, Anton who is trying to outdo his father by raising an army of mercenaries to fight in America's Middle Eastern conflicts, triggering a father-son rivalry.

movies.title: The Take
movies.overview: A bank guard, a teller and a master thief play a deadly game of cons and double-crosses.

movies.title: Look Back
movies.overview: Popular, outgoing Fujino is celebrated by her classmates for her funny comics in the class newspaper. One day, her teacher asks her to share the space with Kyomoto, a truant recluse whose beautiful artwork sparks a competitive fervor in Fujino. What starts as jealousy transforms when Fujino realizes their shared passion for drawing.

movies.title: Artificial
movies.overview: In November 2023, amidst the height of a global AI boom, OpenAI co-founder Ilya Sutskever teamed with the company board to make one of the defining decisions that has drastically reshaped the company as we know it, the firing of current CEO Sam Altman. This controversial decision would lead to immense backlash, ultimately resulting in Altman's return five days later.

movies.title: Zero A.D.: The Birth of Christ
movies.overview: A star rises over Bethlehem as Christ is born. But when Herod orders the slaughter of the innocents, Mary and Joseph must protect the child promised to save the world.

movies.title: King
movies.overview: Mentor and disciple embark on a perilous journey, pushing their survival skills to the limit against overwhelming odds and unforgiving environments.

movies.title: Rose
movies.overview: In the early 17th century, a soldier arrives at an isolated Protestant village in Germany claiming to be the heir to an abandoned farmstead. Even though he proves to be a good man, the villagers’ suspicions about his identity grow and they force a reckoning.

movies.title: George Michael: The Faith Tour
movies.overview: A stunning delve into George Michael's 1988 Faith Tour, as shot live at the famous Palais Omnisports de Paris-Bercy. This exclusive footage, assembled from a 14-camera shoot captured on 35mm over two nights (30–31 May 1988), features the 24-year-old pop star at the height of his powers.

movies.title: Ink
movies.overview: After buying a struggling British tabloid in 1969, mogul Rupert Murdoch and editor Larry Lamb banded together a group of misfits and visionaries to reshape the image of the news industry as we know it.

movies.title: Remain
movies.overview: When reclusive architect Tate Gordon moves to small coastal town to complete his latest project, he encounters an alluring young woman who pulls him out of his shell, and into the center of a deadly mystery that hangs over the town.

movies.title: The Red Hangar
movies.overview: Chile, 1973. The military coup will force Jorge Silva, an Air Force captain, to face the unfolding horror. Inside a military base, he must choose between becoming part of the repression or helping those fighting to stay alive.

movies.title: Mr. Irrelevant
movies.overview: The last player selected in the 1983 NFL draft by the New York Giants, underdog John Tuggle, defies expectations on and off the field for head coach Bill Parcells, his newfound love, and his team, proving that remarkable hope and perseverance can transcend even the greatest challenges.

movies.title: River
movies.overview: After the death of their father, three siblings take a boat trip to spread their dad's ashes. However, they discover they have inadvertently stumbled onto the hunting grounds of a strange pair of masked killers, and must fight for their lives on a busted motorboat.

movies.title: Drag
movies.overview: A routine robbery at a rural house turns into a nightmare for two amateur burglars when one of them throws their back out. Things spiral out of control as they try to make it out before the homeowner returns.

movies.title: Pendulum
movies.overview: A couple, journeys to a retreat in New Mexico seeking healing. Patrick grows skeptical of the retreat's leader as Abigail falls under her influence. They wonder if the group's practices offer genuine healing or conceal a terrifying truth.

movies.title: Slayground
movies.overview: Scare-actor "Metal Mike" Graves wakes up in a haunted attraction surrounded by the dead bodies of his co-workers with no memory of how they got there. As a state-wide manhunt closes in, he races to uncover the truth — even if the trail leads straight back to himself.

movies.title: Iron Boy
movies.overview: In rural France, 10-year-old Christophe tries to live up to his rigid and distant father on the family farm. But the young boy starts to lean over and collapse without warning — on the tractor, at school, at dinner... A doctor finds the solution: Christophe must wear an iron corset to keep himself upright. Forced to reinvent his life away from the farm, Christophe discovers a new passion for music, meets a new friend, and follows her into his first mischief. But will any of this really fix what is out of balance?

movies.title: The Rescue
movies.overview: A former rodeo cowboy takes matters into his own hands when his daughter is kidnapped for ransom. With her devoted dog by his side, he sets out to bring her home and will stop at nothing to find her.

movies.title: Animal Friends
movies.overview: Two fugitive animals embark on an adventure across America to find the ranch that was once their home, healing their friendship while pursued by an equally "odd-couple" DEA agent and Fish and Wildlife ranger with something to prove.

movies.title: Cloud Girl
movies.overview: The adventures of a young girl named Providence, who is entrusted with a magic quill that makes everything she writes come true. Faced with this incredible power, she has to choose between living her dreams and saving the world.

movies.title: Bunker
movies.overview: When an architect accepts a morally ambiguous project — building a survivalist bunker for a tech billionaire — his wife of 17 years begins to question their relationship.

movies.title: Clarissa
movies.overview: Across a single day in Lagos, Nigeria, Clarissa prepares to host a high society party at her home, as her complicated past begins to consume her, in the form of now-distant friends and loves from her youth. Simultaneously, Septimus, a young soldier, is haunted by his own memories of the horrors he has witnessed and endured. As the perspectives traverse past and present, across the bourgeois class and those too easily forgotten by society, a delicate portrait of contemporary Nigeria emerges.

movies.title: Witch on the Holy Night
movies.overview: Near the end of the Showa era in the late 1980s, in Misaki town, an old mansion is rumored to be the home of a witch. After moving into the mansion, Aoko Aozaki begins to learn sorcery from a young mage, Alice Kuonji, the rumored witch of the mansion. The Aozaki family oversees the land on which Misaki is built and the heir (Aoko) is tasked with protecting it. Mysterious intruders have been disrupting the bounded field in Misaki, leading Alice and Aoko to investigate. A mannequin or puppet attacks them and is incinerated. As this happens, both of them spot someone running away, a civilian who must not get away having seen magic alive. Unexpectedly, a young boy named Soujuurou Shizuki is drawn to the mansion and comes to reside with them as well.

movies.title: To Hold a Mountain
movies.overview: In the remote highlands of Montenegro, a shepherd mother and daughter proudly defend their ancestral mountain from the threat of becoming a NATO military training ground, stirring memories of the violence that shattered their family.

movies.title: The Night of Broken Glass
movies.overview: Police Lieutenant Krützfeld faces a momentous decision on the night of November 9, 1938, in Berlin. Following the assassination of a German attaché in Paris, wrongfully labelled a Jewish terrorist attack by Nazi propaganda, he receives the order to attack the Jewish quarter. As chaos erupts, Krützfeld must choose whether to obey the command or protect the innocent.

movies.title: The Day She Returns
movies.overview: ​Having stepped back from acting after marriage and a subsequent divorce, actress Bae Jeongsu returns to the profession with a role in an independent film. As the film’s release approaches, she takes part in a series of press interviews, only to discover later, when asked to revisit those moments in her acting class, that she cannot clearly recall what was said.

movies.title: FING!
movies.overview: Myrtle's parents will do anything to make her happy, even track down a strange creature in a remote jungle. But when a greedy wildlife park owner takes the rare Fing, the family must pull off a daring rescue to save their magical friend.

movies.title: The Comeback King
movies.overview: A country western star named Aubrey must return to college to earn his long-abandoned degree after a false rumor that he cheated on his girlfriend throws his career into free fall.

movies.title: Rehearsals for a Revolution
movies.overview: Through five portraits of relatives and mentors, five expressions of resistance, Pegah Ahangarani sketches her life story. Drawing from personal archives, home videos, street protests footage, newspapers, and recorded voices, she retraces more than 40 years of Iran’s history. From the early days of 1979, until the war that began in 2026, she pieces together intimate and collective memories, forming the portrait of a country shaped by political repression and in constant hope for a revolution.

movies.title: Air Bud Returns
movies.overview: 12-year-old Jacob is an aspiring basketball player coping with the recent loss of his father. After he and his mother move to his dad’s childhood home in Fernfield, Jacob discovers a VHS tape of his old man playing basketball on the same court as a hoops-shooting golden retriever. Soon, Jacob begins his own adventure with a neglected golden retriever that he names Buddy.

movies.title: The Third Parent
movies.overview: A neighborhood Fourth of July celebration is interrupted by a ferociously bizarre anomaly who overpowers a family in order to teach them how to become better people and more compliant citizens.

movies.title: Castration Movie ⅗ Year of the Hyaena
movies.overview: Michaela tries her best to be a good person.

movies.title: Killing Castro
movies.overview: In 1960, Fidel Castro comes to America to speak at the UN. He is invited by Malcolm X to stay in Harlem at the famous Hotel Theresa. Unsure of his intentions, the FBI, CIA and the Mafia, all attempt to eliminate him by any means necessary.

movies.title: Nicolás de Jesús' Now You See Me...
movies.overview: Struggling fair owner Kesselring (Nicolás de Jesús) is given a unique opportunity to restore the fair to its former glory when his friend Dr. Goodkat (Fredy Roque) introduces him to Marcus Kelevra (Alexis Adrián), a man whose mysterious act will draw people back to the fair, at a deadly cost, and even sparking interest among his fellow fairgoers.

movies.title: The Poolrooms
movies.overview: A teenager trapped inside a seemingly endless aquatic labyrinth of swimming pools, towering waterslides, flooded corridors, and impossible architecture. As he ventures deeper into the surreal liminal maze and reality itself begins to unravel, a mysterious creature stalks him from beneath the water, forcing him to find a way out before he disappears forever.

movies.title: Kung Fu Panda 5
movies.overview: Upcoming fifth film in the popular animated franchise, continuing Po’s journey as a spiritual leader. Plot TBA.

movies.title: The Secret Lives of Baba Segi's Wives
movies.overview: A rich patriarch's delicate family falls apart when his youngest of four wives cannot have a child.

movies.title: Dada
movies.overview: A stylish and uncompromising underworld don aggressively conquers the lawless Mumbai streets, weaponizing his fierce trademark justice to systematically dismantle a lethal corporate criminal syndicate.

movies.title: January 12 Vidudala
movies.overview: Two army officers and best friends, Venkat Reddy and Bal Reddy, are very efficient in handling crises situations regarding national defense. When Bal Reddy returns to his native village, he encounters an unexpected rift in within a family divided by tradition, identity, and pride. Venkat Reddy steps in to heal the growing rift, but faces unimaginable difficulties in the process.

movies.title: Apophis 2029
movies.overview: On April 13, 2029, the asteroid Apophis will pass close enough to Earth, it will be below our satellites. It will dip below and pop back out.

movies.title: Starlight
movies.overview: Spanning multiple generations and continents, Starlight follows the poignant journeys of four main characters as they traverse the bittersweet chapters of their lives, culminating in their ultimate struggles to overcome overwhelming obstacles relating to cancer. Yet, the heart of the film lies beyond the disease itself; it is a narrative of hope celebrating the power and perseverance of the human spirit, embodied and personified by these characters and their ability to triumph spectacularly against all odds.
